newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sight deposits reflect continued flexibility - SNB.
newsitem.headline: Sight deposits reflect continued flexibility - SNB.

text.p: The relatively high levels of sight deposits reported for first 10 days of September indicated the Swiss National Bank's (SNB) continued flexible mode, an SNB spokesman said.
"It (early September sight deposits) reflects the continued flexible stance of the Swiss National Bank in the money market," an SNB spokesman said.
Swiss sight deposits for the reporting period to September 10 rose by 187.8 million Swiss francs to a relatively high 3,206.1 million.
The SNB in recent weeks has confirmed that it has been adding liquidity to the money market and in late August said its directors had decided to add a "significant quantity" of liquidity.
Analysts have said this latest SNB stance reflects an effort to abate upward pressure on market rates as long as the Swiss franc remains strong in foreign exchange markets.
Swiss money market rates were easier this morning, but at that time dealers said the SNB was absent from the market. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
